description: Both outputs of an If node connect to the same No Operation node, so that node has two connections into input 0. v1 runs it twice: first with a2 and a3, then with a0 and a1. Three readers after it are Code nodes and an Edit Fields node, and a fourth is an HTTP Request node whose URL reads the item of the split node A in a parameter expression. $('A').item gives the item with the same id in every run.
